Problem Statement:
Pandi is a 20 year old Engineering student living in Coimbatore. He is an avid user of Tinder app, a social dating application. At the beginning stage of his dating life i.e. first two months, he swiped right on all the profiles. On the fore coming months he became a bit choosey in swiping right. So the number profiles per each right swipe kept increasing as the sum of the previous two months profiles per right swipe count. Given Nth month, your task is to find out how many profiles Pandi will look into for each right swipe? 
Input Description:
One single Integer 'N'
1 
Output Description:
One single integer value of number of profiles Pandi looks for each right swipe 
Sample Input:
7 
Sample Output:
13 
Explanation:
Pandi will take 13 wipes for each right swipe
